title: Maria's School Day
text:
Maria is a student at a technical school in Sao Paulo. She studies computers and English three days a week. Her school has a small library and a computer lab, so she can practise every day. Maria wants to work in an office after she finishes school.

Her teacher, Mr. Costa, helps students find jobs. Last month he invited a company to the school for an interview day. Maria was nervous, but she practised her answers at home with her sister. She hopes that one day she will get a good job with a friendly team.

questions.text: How many days a week does Maria study computers and English?
What did Mr. Costa invite to the school last month?
options: A company for an interview day

questions.text: Why was Maria probably nervous before the interview day?
options: She did not want to work at all
It was an important step toward her first real job
Her teacher was angry with her

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Maria's future?
options: She is likely to keep working hard to get a job
She plans to move to another country next week
She does not want to work in an office

vocabulary.definition: to do an activity many times in order to improve
a room or building where books are kept for people to read or borrow
a formal meeting where someone asks questions to decide if a person is right for a job
feeling worried or anxious about something

paragraph_translations: Maria é estudante de uma escola técnica em São Paulo. Ela estuda informática e inglês três dias por semana. A escola tem uma pequena biblioteca e um laboratório de informática, então ela pode praticar todos os dias. Maria quer trabalhar em um escritório depois que terminar a escola.

Seu professor, o Sr. Costa, ajuda os alunos a encontrar emprego. No mês passado, ele convidou uma empresa para a escola em um dia de entrevistas. Maria estava nervosa, mas praticou as respostas em casa com sua irmã. Ela espera que um dia consiga um bom emprego em uma equipe simpática.
